original_test_intent: Upgrade BMC firmware through the supported management path while preserving intended configuration, then verify target version and BMC service health.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: In BMC WebUI upload `.ima`, select Preserve all Configuration, flash, and check version.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Target BMC version is active and preserved services/configuration remain healthy.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; prohibited a guessed generic Redfish endpoint and required an exhaustive preservation matrix.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: WebUI path is engineer-operated unless the exact platform advertises an approved API; agent may guide and analyze evidence.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: WebUI `.ima` BMC upgrade with Preserve all Configuration.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Exact target/image/version/compatibility, supported update path, preservation matrix, activation, rollback and approval.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: An API method must prove equivalent component, preservation and activation coverage.

original_method: The WebUI workflow and preserve-all selection remain intact.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the exact platform's advertised/vendor-documented firmware update interface; keep WebUI if that is the supported method.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BMC board, firmware and update service.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Current and target versions plus compatibility must be confirmed.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform vendor BMC update manual; DMTF Redfish UpdateService only when advertised by the target.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: May automate the same update transaction but cannot substitute generic URI guesses for the WebUI test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Must preserve the signed configuration matrix and post-update services.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Image provenance/hash/signature, advertised endpoint or WebUI SOP, task/activation rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong image, power interruption or incomplete preservation can brick or deconfigure management.

missing_inputs: Compatible signed image and target identity
safety_boundaries: No wrong component/image, power interruption or automatic retry
No secret exposure or log clearing
expected_evidence: Pre/post version and full preservation-matrix diff
no_automatic_retry: A failed flash is preserved; recovery or retry requires new approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: BMC firmware engineer owns the result.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already kept WebUI coverage distinct from API automation and prioritized the platform-supported update mechanism.
